metrics.label: Pass rate
metrics.basis: passed tests over executed tests (skipped tests excluded)

metrics.label: Requirement coverage
metrics.basis: requirements with at least one approved test case over all requirements

metrics.label: Script executability
metrics.basis: scripts whose test ran to a pass or a fail (no error) over scripts generated

metrics.label: Healing success rate
metrics.basis: steps with a proposed locator over steps that asked for healing

metrics.label: Classification accuracy
metrics.basis: failures whose category equals the supplied label over labelled failures

metrics.label: Generation latency (median)
metrics.basis: analyze and generate steps of the three generation components, LLM time included

metrics.label: LLM call latency (median)
metrics.basis: gateway calls to the provider (mock or live, see the provider label)

metrics.label: API cost
metrics.basis: sum of token costs of the runs involved (zero for the mock provider)

metrics.label: API cost per run
metrics.basis: API cost divided by the 2 run(s) involved
